title: Foo Fighters, Noah Kahan, The Who set to headline Jazz Fest. See the full lineup

 Advertisement Updated: 11:20 AM CST Nov 19, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Erin Lowrey New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival releases 2027 music lineup
 Updated: 11:20 AM CST Nov 19, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Erin Lowrey The New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival released its 2027 music lineup on Thursday. 
 The lineup, which was released earlier than in years past, features big headliners like The Foo Fighters, Noah Kahan, The Who, and more.
 Advertisement Louisiana natives PJ Morton, Irma Thomas, and Tank and the Bangas are also on the lineup. 
 Other big headliners include Gwen Stefani, James Taylor, LL Cool J, Mannie Fresh with Juvenile & T.I., Matchbox Twenty, and Widespread Panic.
 To see the full lineup, click here. 
 The two-weekend festival will be held at the Fair Grounds from April 22 through May 2.
